findings.title: Invalid global manifests and dependency metadata can return PASS
findings.scope: global input validity / workspace metadata closure
findings.expected: Malformed manifest/workspaces/dependency shapes block the audit globally, even for an unrelated product workspace.
findings.observed: 7 malformed metadata inputs return PASS with no diagnostics.
findings.mechanism: JSON.parse validates syntax only. Missing workspaces defaults to []; pkg.name is inserted without type validation; Object.keys on spread dependency arrays/strings produces indices rather than dependency names. Thus metadata roots can be silently dropped.
findings.strongestProof: dependency-array: packages/core/package.json has dependencies:["@neutral/consumer"], but no product edge or invalid-input diagnostic is reported.
findings.impact: The gate emits a green status for invalid global inputs. This is a scoped fail-closed defect; it does not demonstrate execution, real-data access, or a bypass with a valid manifest.
findings.recommendation: Lead should validate manifest/workspaces/name/dependency shapes before deriving roots or pruning diagnostics; preserve separate product quality gates and add inert regression cases. No fix applied.

proofHighlights.lexical: 80 wrapper pattern identities + 20 class-static/catch identities + 4 Annex-B initializer write targets + 3 parameter/body directed transfers, all native and unmodified.
proofHighlights.assignment: 35 assignedValues pattern selection relations + 7 valueBranches joins. Abstract helper proofs use original AST identifiers, not stub capabilities or native claims.
proofHighlights.scalar: 21 own neutral receiver invocation cases through 7 wrappers remain INCOMPLETE; 7 stable own-scalar positives PASS; 7 selected unknown patterns remain INCOMPLETE; mutation/alias/getter uncertainty retained.
proofHighlights.reachability: Unrelated product/legacy/vendor/top-level test diagnostics pruned; literal/transitive legacy, all four workspace dependency roots, rooted/reached tests, real vendor implementation instead of .d.ts, vendor parse/unresolved/nonliteral cases remain INCOMPLETE. Literal and metadata product edges FAIL. Empty core remains INCOMPLETE. Syntax/config/path/source-link invalidity blocks.

limits: No installed/global/production acceptance; real installed scan remains INCOMPLETE.

Ordinary trusted Vitest worker threads and existing physical module resolver subprocesses are infrastructure, not fixture execution or subagents.
